title: MoukhlijMatExtract (MME): extraction, ranking and classification of solid-state-electrolyte data from scientific papers
description: MoukhlijMatExtract extracts activation energies, ionic and electronic conductivities and diffusion coefficients of solid-state electrolytes from scientific papers (local PDFs and legal open-access copies found on the web), with the material, the conditions, the moving species and the provenance of every value; ranks the materials by activation energy and classifies them by crystal-structure type and structure family. It records how each result was made (run manifests, requirements.lock) and measures its own accuracy against annotated papers (mme-eval).
